<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem asks whether customers can confirm platform integration with existing systems (policyholder data, third-party adjusters, legacy document tools). None of the five similar items addresses integrations or integration transparency: the closest stories concern policyholder milestone notifications, October release notes (document upload speeds, error logging), supplier address fields, organisation settings, and the completed Workspace administration feature (permissions/settings/teams), none of which solves the integration-uncertainty problem. The completed Workspace administration story covers internal administration, not external system integration. No roadmap item or shipped story covers this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
